program.name: Antalya Easter 2027
program.description:
## A week on the Turkish Riviera

Seven nights in Antalya over the Easter holidays, when the sea is warming up and the resorts are at their quietest. The package puts together a charter flight from Sofia, transfers on both ends, a choice of three all-inclusive hotels on the Lara and Belek coast, and medical travel insurance, so the only decision left is which pool to sit by.

### Who it is for

Families with school-age children, couples who want a week of guaranteed sun before the summer rush, and groups travelling together who want everything handled by one operator.

### How it works

Choose the departure and the hotel at booking time. Prices come live from the hotel system and already include transport, transfers and insurance. Seats on the charter are limited and allocated in booking order.

content.tagline: 7 nights all-inclusive with a direct charter from Sofia
content.summary: A week of early-season sun in Antalya: direct charter from Sofia, transfers, medical insurance and a choice of three all-inclusive hotels on the Lara and Belek coast, all in one price.
highlights: Direct charter Sofia → Antalya, about 1 h 45 min in the air
Three hand-picked all-inclusive hotels on the Lara and Belek coast
Festive Easter-week programme and themed dinners at every hotel
Transfers, insurance and resort taxes already in the price
Optional excursions: Perge and Aspendos, Düden waterfalls, Antalya old town
inclusions: Return charter flight Sofia (SOF) – Antalya (AYT) with 20 kg checked baggage and 8 kg hand luggage
7 nights at the chosen hotel on an all-inclusive basis
Medical travel insurance for the duration of the trip
exclusions: Personal expenses, mini-bar and spa treatments
Visa, where required by the traveller's nationality
content.transportDetails:
Charter flight operated by a Bulgarian carrier.

- **Outbound:** Sofia (SOF) 06:30 → Antalya (AYT) 09:15 local time
- **Return:** Antalya (AYT) 10:30 → Sofia (SOF) 11:20 local time
- 20 kg checked baggage and 8 kg hand luggage per person
- Flight times are indicative and confirmed 48 hours before departure
content.practicalInfo:
- **Documents:** a passport or Bulgarian ID card valid for at least 6 months after the return date. Bulgarian citizens do not need a visa for stays of up to 90 days.
- **Currency:** Turkish lira; euros and cards are accepted in the resorts.
- **Weather:** 20–24 °C by day in early April, sea around 18 °C; evenings are cool, bring a light jacket.
- **Time zone:** Turkey is one hour ahead of Bulgaria.
- **Health:** no vaccinations required; tap water is not for drinking.
content.cancellationPolicy:
- More than 30 days before departure: full refund minus a 50 EUR per person processing fee.
- 30 to 15 days before departure: 50% of the package price is retained.
- 14 to 8 days before departure: 75% is retained.
- 7 days or less, or no-show: 100% is retained.

Name changes are free up to 7 days before departure, subject to the carrier's rules.
content.paymentTerms: 30% deposit within 3 working days of confirmation; the balance is due 21 days before departure. Bookings made within 21 days of departure are paid in full at confirmation. Bank transfer or card.
content.insurancePolicy: Medical travel insurance with 10 000 EUR cover for emergency treatment, hospitalisation and repatriation is included for every traveller. Trip-cancellation cover is optional and must be added at the time of booking. Pre-existing conditions are excluded unless declared and accepted by the insurer.
content.childPolicy: Children aged 2–11 sharing a room with two adults travel at the child rate shown at booking. Infants under 2 pay only the airline fee and do not get a seat. Ages count on the return date.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Antalya
itinerary.description: Morning charter from Sofia. Group transfer to the hotel (about 30 minutes), check-in from 14:00, welcome briefing with the representative at 18:00.

itinerary.title: Beach day
itinerary.description: A free day at the hotel. The representative is at the lobby desk 10:00–12:00 to book excursions.

itinerary.title: Antalya old town (optional)
itinerary.description: Half-day walk through Kaleiçi: Hadrian's Gate, the clock tower, the old harbour and the bazaar. Return by 15:00.

itinerary.title: Perge and Aspendos (optional)
itinerary.description: Full-day excursion to the Roman city of Perge and the theatre of Aspendos, with lunch in Side.

itinerary.title: Festive day at the resort
itinerary.description: Themed lunch and an evening show at the hotel. Pools, spa and the beach as usual.

itinerary.title: Düden waterfalls and Lara beach (optional)
itinerary.description: Half-day trip to the upper and lower Düden waterfalls, then free time on Lara beach.

itinerary.title: Free day
itinerary.description: Last full day at the resort. Return flight times are confirmed by the representative in the evening.

itinerary.title: Return to Sofia
itinerary.description: Check-out by 12:00 (late check-out subject to availability), transfer to the airport and the midday flight home.
